SharedPoolPriceFeed

Canonical REP/collateral reporting and price source for every question in one security pool and universe. SharedPoolPriceFeed source contract

Read surface

Accepted price and freshness: lastPrice, lastSettlementTimestamp, priceValidUntil and isPriceValid. Pending reports do not extend freshness. Reports retain isolated sponsor-owned escrows. Configuration, exposure and candidate getters: reportCandidates, reportOutcome, universeId, reputationToken, aggregateExposureAttoEth, validateExposure, conservativePrice, liquidationPrice, minimumToken1ReportAttoEth, minimumToken2ReportAttoRep, minimumToken1ReportAttoEthForPrice, getSettlementCallbackGasLimit, getRequestPriceCostAttoEth, reportAuthorization, priceValidityWindowSeconds, timeType, trackDisputes, OPEN_INTEREST_DIVIDER, REPORT_OPERATION_GAS_OVERHEAD, MAXIMUM_REPORT_OPERATION_DATA_BYTES, FEED_SETTLEMENT_GAS_OVERHEAD, securityPoolFactory, securityPool, openOracle, collateralToken, minimumReportCollateral, weth, initialReportPriorityFeeAttoEthPerGas, targetPriceErrorForDispute, settlementTime, disputeDelay, protocolFee, feePercentage, multiplier, protocolFeeRecipient, escalationHaltMultiplierBps, maxSettlementBaseFeeMultiplierBps, pendingReportId, pendingReportSponsor, pendingReportMaxSettlementBaseFeeAttoEthPerGas, acceptedExposureLimitAttoEth, acceptedRepExposureLimitAttoRep, acceptedEpoch, sponsorOperationReport.

Security assumptions

Report liveness depends on A16 timely inclusion, A17 corrector capability, A18 independent correction incentive, A19 observable correctable price, and A06 lifecycle executors.

State-changing interactions

The contract index defines the columns.

Transaction Caller Main prerequisites State or asset effect Primary signals
requestSecurityPoolPrice(proposedRepPerEthPrice, requestedInitialAttoWeth, bountyAttoEth) Anyone Approve this feed for exact collateral and REP; positive price; sufficient report stake; msg.value covers the committed bounty; excess ETH is refunded after candidate storage is complete; reporting window open. Opens an independently funded report. Collateral and REP move directly from the caller to its isolated escrow; the caller receives returned funding. PriceRequested, ReportFundingAssigned
requestSecurityPoolPriceWithOperations(proposedRepPerEthPrice, requestedInitialAttoWeth, bountyAttoEth, batch) Anyone Same funding checks; unexpired batch, price bounds and sufficient bounded callback gas. Opens a report and retains the caller as sponsor for ordered bounded capital operations after acceptance. PriceRequested, ReportFundingAssigned, ReportOperationAttempted
createReportEscrow(payer, sponsor, wethAmount, repAmount, haltAmount, bounty, callbackGasLimit) This feed only Authenticated self-call from report creation; OpenOracle amount and bounty widths already checked. Creates the report escrow and pulls caller-funded tokens into it atomically. OpenOracle report creation
settleReport(reportId, amount1, amount2) The registered report escrow only Known pending candidate; authenticated escrow callback. Validates report economics, freshness, base-fee ceiling and exposure. An acceptance records the candidate and canonical prices before sponsor operations use the canonical price. PriceCandidateAccepted, PriceReported, PriceReportRejected, PriceReportDeferred, ReportOperationAttempted
recoverReport(reportId) Anyone Known unprocessed report with nonzero settlement timestamp. Accepting its price or attempting operations under a fresh canonical price requires base fee at or below its cap; other invalid candidates can retire above the cap. Retries a settled candidate using stored OpenOracle amounts and timestamps. Funding withdrawal remains separate. PendingReportRecovered and report outcome events
recoverSettledPendingReport() Anyone Latest candidate is settled and recoverable. Recovers the latest pending candidate through recoverReport. PendingReportRecovered and report outcome events
